metadata.methodology: Cross-referenced morphology index terms against data/root-occurrences/ includedLemmas arrays and occurrence token-to-lemma mappings using STRICT normalized Arabic matching (diacritics stripped, hamzas normalized, prefixes/suffixes removed). No partial/substring matching used to prevent false positives. Verb forms inferred using standard Arabic morphology (Forms I-X). Noun patterns inferred using standard templates (fa'l, fā'il, maf'ūl, mif'āl, etc.). All results marked pending-scholarly-review. Null lemma = insufficient evidence; fields NOT populated merely to eliminate nulls.
